title: Injective-resolution and derived connecting maps agree
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian] with enough injectives, let $M$ be an object, and let $0\to A\to B\to C\to0$ be a short exact sequence. Define $\operatorname{Ext}^n_{\mathcal A}(M,-)$ both as the right derived functors of $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal A}(M,-)$ computed by injective resolutions [def-sp-injective-resolutions] and as $\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\mathcal A)}(M[0],-[0][n])$ [def-pc-ext]. Under the canonical comparison between these descriptions [lem-weil-pbc-ext-via-injective-resolution], the connecting morphism in the injective-resolution long exact sequence for $\operatorname{Ext}^n_{\mathcal A}(M,-)$ is the homology connecting morphism induced by the distinguished triangle $A[0]\to B[0]\to C[0]\to A[0][1]$ in the derived category.

source.place: Tags 05TE and 06XR: right-derived functors form the canonical delta-functor, and Ext is computed by injective resolutions and identified with derived-category morphisms
